headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — HYDERABAD
not_verified: identity of the vehicle and driver
key_facts: 57-year-old Women & Child Welfare Dept employee (Shadnagar) died
unidentified vehicle rammed his scooter from rear on NH-44, Shamshabad, Fri 11 Sep ~11.30-11:40 am, near Agarwal Estate / Old Madanpally Thanda
died at scene; case registered; CCTV being examined
bullets_en: A 57-year-old government employee died when an unidentified vehicle hit his scooter from behind on NH-44 at Shamshabad, police said.
The accident happened on Friday morning near Agarwal Estate, Old Madanpally Thanda, as he travelled to his duty in Shadnagar.
Shamshabad police have registered a case and are examining CCTV footage to trace the vehicle and driver.
bullets_ur: Police ke mutabiq Shamshabad mein NH-44 par ek 57-sala government employee ki maut ho gayi, jab ek anjaan vehicle ne unki scooter ko peeche se takkar maari.
Haadsa Friday subah Agarwal Estate, Old Madanpally Thanda ke qareeb pesh aaya; woh Shadnagar mein apni duty par ja rahe the.
Shamshabad police ne case darj karke CCTV footage ke zariye vehicle aur driver ki talash shuru kar di hai.
